attribution: Internal exact negative-shadow countercontrol.
novelty: Candidate project-specific formulation/application; historical priority not established.
limitations: Does not refute full reservoir, inverse paths, recursive receivers or universal convergence.
significance: Excludes an entire fixed-preview method rather than only a tested table.

title: Uniform reciprocal-log budget for repeated expanding words
statement: A legal no-descent burst of >=2 repetitions of an expanding odd word has total reciprocal-log cost <2/log(4/3), independently of the word; rotated >=3-copy version has bound3/log(4/3).
assumptions: Positive+1 affine offset; exact legal repeated word; specified descent/rotation guards.
proof_summary: With A=3^m,Q=2^H,B<Q^log2(3), k copies imply Q^k divides positive (A-Q)X+B. Infer X+1>Q^(k-log2 3) and sum uniform reciprocal-log bounds.
attribution: Internal bound; elementary divisibility and positive affine intercept.
novelty: Candidate project-specific formulation/application; historical priority not established.
limitations: Infinitely many fresh bursts can renew; 3n-1 cycle at5 shows positive intercept nonvanishing is essential.
significance: Word-independent restricted escape cost, not summability over all future renewals.

title: Individual leading phase law does not imply trailing-depth fairness
statement: Any hypothetical nonperiodic positive S_c orbit with odd c>=3 has log2(n_i) mod1 uniformly distributed.
assumptions: Positive actual orbit with no repetition, hence n_i->infinity; c odd>=3.
proof_summary: Phase increments are irrational log2 c plus error log2(1+1/(c n_i))->0. Fourier telescoping gives each nonzero mode mean zero, hence Weyl uniform distribution.
attribution: Standard irrational-rotation/Weyl argument adapted; antecedent also in earlier GDR2 cycle05 record.
novelty: Candidate project-specific formulation/application; historical priority not established.
limitations: Leading real mantissa phase says nothing by itself about future trailing2-adic depth statistics.
significance: An individual-orbit constraint, stronger in quantifier than population-density heuristics but not convergence.

title: Injective-set packing implies reciprocal summability of an escaping orbit
statement: If A subset[0,32^m) has T^(5m) injective, |A|<=2*27^m+(3125/108)^m. This yields sum1/T^tN finite for every escaping shortcut orbit, hence bounded affine correction and m log2 3-H_m->infinity.
assumptions: Equal-time injectivity on distinct orbit states; escaping, not periodic, orbit.
map_clock: Shortcut packing horizon5m and odd-round discrepancy
proof_summary: Split parity words by odd count3m: low count images lie in small interval, high-count words bounded by Chernoff3/2. Dyadic shells sum reciprocals; normalized product formula gives discrepancy consequence.
attribution: Immediate CR09 argument credits Michael Sharpe pinned OrbitPacking.lean/OrbitSummability.lean commit ec8174b567d5cab4960024782210b5f5db02bd3a. García–Tal1999 collision-free-window mechanism and GDR2 cycle05 October15 transport are prior antecedents; see literature chapter.
novelty: External/antecedent result; do not present as new discovery.
limitations: No Lean build in this audit; discrepancy->infinity does not imply a uniform positive mean drift. Summability is a necessary escape condition, not an exclusion.
significance: Important established/credited individual-orbit constraint, not project novelty.

title: Universal closure remains an open bridge
statement: Universal Collatz convergence would follow from any genuinely instantiated all-target certificate assembler, universal signed-row elimination, or target-pinned dual-witness exclusion; none is established in audited reports.
assumptions: Every quantified target/source, exact guards, fixed original source ownership, complete terminal contexts.
proof_summary: Restricted proofs and countercontrols delimit missing all-target coverage or well-foundedness. Labels full proof refer to conditional architectures or restricted theorems.
attribution: Internal research program; no priority/proof claim.
novelty: Not a theorem; explicit research frontier.
limitations: Finite prefixes, local finite states, bounded-dimensional encodings, weighted decay and fixed-q finiteness do not supply missing universal bridge.
significance: The indispensable publication-facing status statement.
